title: Government underfunding meant no helicopter for UAP events

tellings.quote: part of our disappointment in the government consisted of insufficient financing when we received funds for these measures.

plain: A spokesperson for Skywatcher, a startup that tries to call in UFOs (which officials call UAP, unidentified anomalous phenomena) and record them, says the government funded some of its observation events in the western United States between about 2020 and 2025 but never gave enough money, so there was no helicopter to chase what appeared. The company, linked to a man named Jake Barber, speaks of "our disappointment in the government" over "insufficient financing".
